description: Legal citation and quotation verifier (US case law) — Extracts US reporter citations from a brief (U.S., S. Ct., L. Ed., F., F.2d, F.3d, F.4th, F. Supp., state and regional reporters) and checks each against Harvard's Caselaw Access Project and, when the operator has configured a token, the CourtListener Citation Lookup API. Reports FOUND, MISMATCH (case name, year or circuit differs), NOT_FOUND, AMBIGUOUS, or UNCHECKED with the reason, and never mar

check_propositions.description: Default false. Runs one optional model call that may only point at a verified passage.

citations.description: Citations to check instead of, or in addition to, text.

max_citations.description: Distinct reporter citations to check. Default 40.

quotes.description: Quotations to find verbatim in the cited opinion.

citation.description: Reporter citation the quote is attributed to.

text.description: Brief or memo text. Citations and their case names, court and year are extracted from it.

name: legal-cite-verifier
